goals:
• Configure iBGP on all routers in AS {{bgp_as}}.
• Configure router {{router1_name}} as the route-reflector for router {{router2_name}} and {{router3_name}}. Use cluster-ID {{router1_loopback_ip}}.
• Configure router {{router4_name}} as the route-reflector for router {{router5_name}} and {{router6_name}}. Use cluster-ID {{router4_loopback_ip}}.
• Configure router {{router7_name}} as the route-reflector for router {{router8_name}} and {{router9_name}}. Use cluster-ID {{router7_loopback_ip}}.
• Configure router {{router1_name}}, {{router4_name}} and {{router7_name}} with the correct IBGP neighbor peerings.
• Advertise all loopback0 interfaces in BGP.
• Ensure you have full reachability within AS {{bgp_as}}. All loopback0 interfaces should be reachable.
